description: S27 T3 (CN7): the graph door. `depend` records that item 12 waits for item 9 — an EDGE OF INTENT, not a status move: the item's own fields do not change, and the answer carries the graph beside the row (`dependencies` names the upstream items with their CURRENT status and title; `dependents` counts who waits on this one). Both fields are additive and omitempty: an edge-less item answers with exactly the bytes it answered with before S27. Readiness is never a field here — the next attempt re-reads the graph (D4: decided now, never cached).
